summary_1line: Bhima keeps watch over his sleeping family as the man-eating rakshasa Hidimva discovers them and sends his sister, who instead falls in love with Bhima.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima sits awake beneath a forest tree guarding his sleeping mother and brothers sprawled on the bare ground at night.
The monstrous rakshasa Hidimva, red‑haired and fanged, crouches on a sala tree licking his lips as he spies the sleeping Pandavas below.
Hidimva’s sister transforms into a beautiful woman adorned with celestial ornaments as she approaches the vigilant Bhima in the dark forest.
